strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Makes Codebase Index build, query, selection-read, selected-index context validation, permission payloads, ledger payloads, and fingerprints maintainable by isolating their Rust implementation into a cohesive module boundary without changing behavior.
Preserves selected-index prompt context materialization for task.run and headless journey admission while making the implementation easier to review for long-running autonomous development.
Preserves runtime-owned IndexCodebase and ReadWorkspace checks, fail-closed selected context validation, bounded ledger payloads, and raw-data exclusion while moving code ownership.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances codebase_indexing release readiness and supports headless_autonomous_development by closing a required-before-release Codebase Index module-decomposition slice.
answers.new_capability: The runtime now has a cohesive codebase_index Rust module boundary for existing Codebase Index build/query/selection-read authority and selected-index context materialization.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Existing Codebase Index behavior worked, but release is blocked by authoritative runtime-module-decomposition debt because Codebase Index execution authority remained embedded in a giant lib.rs editing surface after M64.1-M64.3 extracted different boundaries.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Product completion cannot safely converge while required-before-release runtime module decomposition debt remains open and Codebase Index runtime authority remains hard to review in the monolith.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M64.1 Product Completion, M64.2 Product Continuation, and M64.3 Mode Pack extraction because it moves Codebase Index build/query/selection-read and selected-context helpers; distinct from M63 Product DoD work because it does not change Product DoD evidence behavior.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase adds no JSON-RPC method and preserves codebase.index.build and codebase.index.query dispatch behavior.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, inspection, dashboard, or summary wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Observable runtime behavior is intentionally preserved; the runtime implementation surface changes by moving Codebase Index authority into a module boundary, with semantic equivalence verified by behavior tests.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Selected-index context admission and prompt materialization remain runtime-owned and become more reviewable for headless task and journey flows.
answers.milestone_progress: Adds a fourth bounded partial closure of the authoritative runtime-module-decomposition required-before-release debt without claiming full debt resolution.
